g.text: TCM, DCAA and DCAN: chlorination of ozonated TWP (Ref. 1)
NDMA: chloramination of PAN (Ref. 27; training pH = 8.3 only)
TWP: 16 mg/L as Cl₂, 24 h, 0.15 g/L MP; PAN: 10 mg/L as Cl₂, 72 h, 0.1 g/L MP. DOC missing.
Ticks: observed TWP pH (TCM/DCAA). DCAN and NDMA curves are exploratory; no matched pH gradients.
